# SenseStamp

> SenseStamp makes subscription-free, hub-free ESP32-C6 motion sensors for tamper-proof IoT event logging ("Prove It Happened"). Stick a coin-sized sensor on any door, window, or drawer; every sensor event is HMAC-SHA256 signed on-device before it leaves the hardware, gets a public proof URL, and can be verified with an NFC tap. Alerts are delivered as instant push notifications via iotpush. SenseStamp is currently pre-launch and taking waitlist sign-ups.

## Key facts

- Status: pre-launch; join the waitlist at https://sensestamp.com/#waitlist
- No subscription: buy once, own forever, $0/month
- No hub required; no proprietary app lock-in
- Signed events: HMAC-SHA256 attestation on-device, public proof URLs, NFC tap verification
- Hardware: ESP32-C6 RISC-V, 6-axis IMU, Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2.4GHz & 5GHz), BLE 5.0
- Size: 25x25x8mm, under 10 grams, 3M adhesive backing
- Battery: 400mAh rechargeable Li-ion, USB-C charging, 6+ months typical use
- Protocols: MQTT, HTTP, WebSocket (MQTT support coming for Home Assistant / OpenHAB integration)
- Push alerts by iotpush (https://iotpush.com)
- Roadmap: motion sensors first, then environmental (temperature, humidity, air quality) and audio (glass break, smoke alarm) sensors
